title: Area tag type
text:
Area tag type 

Area details supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.
The Area Tag Type defines the format of the 
Area Tag (area and subarea)
 field value in the Body records. 
 
AreaTagType
 and 
DataLevel

 must match. For example, if you are creating a file containing 
CRESTA
-level exposure
 data for Austria, the Data Level and Area Tag Type must both be '10' and the 
CRESTA
 codes
 in the file must be in the list of Austrian 
CRESTA
 codes.

Locate the Area Tag and Area Tag format for the country in question, then search country by
 
UNICEDE
/2 version to view country/data level information:

UNICEDE/2 v2.9

UNICEDE/2 v2.8

UNICEDE/2 v2.7
